Description: KMS key-policy fragment — bind kms:Sign to the enclave EIF PCR0
Comment: Condition key per AWS docs: kms:RecipientAttestation:ImageSha384 (≡ PCR0). Replace PCR0_HEX with enclave-app/build-enclave.sh → pcr0.txt. This is the independently checkable line that requires a fresh Nitro attestation from that exact enclave image — even the EC2 instance role's IAM kms:Sign grant is useless without it. See Sid SignOnlyWithEnclaveImageAttestation in infra/template.yaml.
